title: One Corner Radius, not two
goal: Pick a rectangle and the panel shows two different sliders both called Corner Radius, one in the Rectangle section and one under Effects. Nobody can tell which one to reach for, or what happens when they disagree. There should be one.
notes: AnnotationContent.cornerRadius (the shape) and LayerStyle.cornerRadius (the non-destructive layer style) are separate fields, both surfaced: AnnotationInspector's radius row and EffectsInspector's Corner Radius slider in Sources/Photonz/LayersPanel.swift. Decide which is the one the panel offers (the style one already speaks for a whole selection) and either fold the other in or stop showing it. Spotted while auditing 2026-09-03-selection-effects.json. RESOLVED by folding, not by dropping either: PhotonzCore/CornerRadiusSelection.swift (selection + setCornerRadius), CornerRadiusRow in Sources/Photonz/LayersPanel.swift, previewCornerRadius/commitCornerRadius in EditorState.swift. Walk: Scripts/playtest/one-corner-radius-walk.json. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-03-one-corner-radius.json.
acceptance: A picked rectangle shows exactly one control called Corner Radius
Rounding a rectangle drawn before this change still looks the same
Rounding still reaches every layer in a multi-selection
Try it: draw a rectangle, round it, and check the panel says one number in one place

log.note: Adversarial review before building: the task note suggested keeping the Effects (LayerStyle) slider, but I reproduced what it actually does to a rectangle first. Rendered a rect annotation three ways offscreen: the shape radius curves the outline properly, the style radius masks the raster and CHOPS the corners clean off the stroke, leaving four disconnected segments. docs/design/tools.md already knew this as the 'rectangle borders disappear when rounded' bug. So neither slider could simply be deleted: the shape one renders right but only exists for rectangles, the style one reaches everything but breaks rectangles.

Decision (mine, not the user's, because it has no visible consequence to weigh): fold them into ONE row rather than hide one. Hiding either leaves two rows in a mixed selection (a rectangle plus a screenshot), which fails the first acceptance item. Folding is the only rule that gives exactly one control for every selection. It sits under Effects, where it already spoke for a whole selection.

Built: PhotonzCore gains CornerRadiusSelection + PhotonzDocument.cornerRadiusSelection/setCornerRadius (14 new tests, TDD). setCornerRadius writes AnnotationContent.cornerRadius for a rectangle and LayerStyle.cornerRadius for everything else, in one pass, and clears the old mask off a rectangle it touches so the two radii can never fight again. ShapeSettingRow.cornerRadius is gone; AnnotationInspector no longer carries a Corner Radius row. EffectsInspector's LayerStyleSlider is replaced by CornerRadiusRow, which previews and commits through EditorState.previewCornerRadius/commitCornerRadius (one undo step, whatever mix it reached) and keeps the next-rectangle default.

Verified on the real app, not assumed. Scripts/playtest/one-corner-radius-walk.json in the probe build (Screen Recording granted, so these are real window captures): one rectangle picked shows exactly ONE Corner Radius row, under Effects, reading 0 pt, with the Rectangle section down to Thickness; one pull rounds it with the outline following the curve; one undo squares it; two rectangles picked still show ONE row, reading Mixed, and one pull rounds both in one step. Re-ran selection-effects-walk and component-look-walk green. Scripts/test.sh green (2449 tests).

Adversarial review of the built thing: the same duplication survives one row down. On a rectangle, Thickness (Rectangle section) and Border (Effects) are both the width of a line round the box. Filed as thickness-and-border-say-the-same-thing-on-a-rec rather than fixed here. Also noted in the audit: a rectangle component copy loses the follow-the-original arrow beside Corner Radius, because its curve is part of the shape rather than part of the look.

One Corner Radius row under Effects, folded from the two that disagreed. CornerRadiusSelection + PhotonzDocument.setCornerRadius in PhotonzCore (14 new tests) write the outline curve for a rectangle and the corner mask for everything else, in one undo step; ShapeSettingRow.cornerRadius is gone and CornerRadiusRow in LayersPanel is the one control. Rounding a rectangle from it now curves the outline instead of chopping the corners off. Verified with real window captures from Scripts/playtest/one-corner-radius-walk.json in the probe build; selection-effects and component-look walks re-run green; Scripts/test.sh green (2449). Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-03-one-corner-radius.json. Follow-up filed: thickness-and-border-say-the-same-thing-on-a-rec.
